documents.title: Master services agreement
documents.text:
Master services agreement — Kestrel Point Holdings (fictional).
In this document "KPHH" means Kestrel Point Holdings. Kestrel Point Holdings reports uptime commitment of 99.84% for FY2025. Kestrel Point Holdings reports termination notice period of 37 days for FY2025 under the amendment no. 1 (supersedes). Kestrel Logistics subsidiary reports term years of 5 years for FY2025. Kestrel Point Holdings reports annual fee of $9.8m for FY2024 on a reported basis. For Kestrel Point Holdings, the data residency obligation is read as: customer data stays within the EEA.

documents.title: Amendment letter
documents.text:
Amendment letter — Kestrel Point Holdings (fictional).
Kestrel Point Holdings reports uptime commitment of 100.04% for FY2025. Kestrel Point Holdings reports termination notice period of 48 days for FY2025 under the original agreement. Kestrel Point Holdings reports maximum service credit of 16.9% for FY2025. Kestrel Point Holdings reports annual price escalator of 3.2% for FY2025. For Kestrel Point Holdings, the data residency obligation is read as: customer data may be processed by approved sub-processors worldwide.

documents.title: Supplier summary memo
documents.text:
Supplier summary memo — Kestrel Point Holdings (fictional).
Kestrel Point Holdings reports term years of 4 years for FY2025. KPHH reports annual fee of $12.3m for FY2024 on a reported basis. Kestrel Point Holdings reports sla credit cap of 14.4% for FY2025. Kestrel Point Holdings reports annual price escalator of 2.6% for FY2025. "sla credit cap" has the same meaning as "service credit".
